description: u--ith change #7 (cross-cutting framing). For security/threat-ratified mitigations the verification question is NEVER 'does it run?' — it is 'does it stop the SPECIFIC attack it names?' 'It works' must not stand in for 'it defeats the threat.' Woven into the verification seats' framing (VERA/CATO/ARGUS + floor-manager/close-gate), not a standalone mechanism.
title: Culture/framing in verification seats: 'does it stop the attack it names?' not 'does it run?' (u--ith #7)
